templates.command: {what} is not in core v2 yet. The legacy compatibility engine requires explicit --core v1 and uses separate legacy state.
templates.notice: {what} is not in core v2 yet.

messages.autosync-listener-ended: listener ended without a stop request
messages.conflict-successor-provenance: The frozen conflict provenance or successor link is missing. Keep both or refresh and review the versions; no files changed.
messages.conflict-successor-missing: A required conflict version is missing. Restore it or keep both and review the remaining versions; no files changed.
messages.conflict-successor-changed: An item changed since this notice. Refresh or dismiss it and review the new state; no files changed.
messages.conflict-successor-foreign: A different item occupies a conflict successor path. Keep both and review that item before retrying; no files changed.
messages.conflict-successor-protected: A conflict successor is excluded, protected, or unreadable. Restore its inclusion or readability and retry; no files changed.
messages.conflict-successor-proof: Verified content proof is unavailable for a conflict successor. Retry after content verification, or keep both and review the versions; no files changed.
messages.startup-executable-invalid: An absolute SyncShark.exe path without quotes is required.
messages.startup-foreign: The Windows startup entry was changed outside Sync Shark and was left untouched.
messages.startup-removed: Removed AutoSync logon startup; running processes are unchanged.
messages.startup-key-unavailable: The per-user startup key could not be opened.
messages.startup-versions-differ: Startup versions differ: {detail}. The stable installed copy is selected only for the same commit-bound build. Use --this-build to explicitly select the running executable.
messages.startup-running-build: Registering the running build. Keep this executable in place, or rerun autosync install-startup after installing an update.
messages.startup-registered: Registered per-user AutoSync logon startup with crash supervision.
messages.startup-repointed: Updated AutoSync logon startup; existing executable targets are preserved while missing targets use the shared executable selection.
messages.startup-repair-failed: AutoSync logon startup could not be updated: {detail} Retry with autosync install-startup; automatic syncing can continue.
messages.proof-parent-guard: Parent identity could not be guarded.
messages.proof-journal-unavailable: A readable journal checkpoint is unavailable.
messages.proof-volume-open: Volume metadata handle could not be opened.
messages.proof-before-read: File identity or journal proof is unavailable or changed.
messages.proof-after-unavailable: File proof is unavailable after reading.
messages.proof-journal-changed: The journal or file proof changed during the read.
messages.proof-content-changed: The file changed while content was read.
messages.proof-path-unavailable: The guarded path identity could not be confirmed after reading.
messages.proof-path-changed: The path now identifies a different file version.
messages.proof-parent-unsafe: The parent identity is unavailable or unsafe.
messages.proof-path-unknown: The listed path identity is unavailable; absence is not proven.
messages.proof-retry-changed: content or stored identity changed during verification; retry on next indexing pass
messages.proof-selection-deferred: content verification deferred by current selection
messages.proof-interrupted: file/journal proof unavailable or changed; make offline/cloud content available, then retry sync
messages.proof-paused: content verification paused during read; retry when activity/power allows
messages.proof-disabled: content verification disabled by byte-rate setting
messages.destination-unobserved: destination not yet observed; creation waits for a successful exact-path read
messages.proof-notice-root: Indexing could not verify this root:
messages.proof-notice-overflow: {0} additional item failures are retained. Use conflicts list with --limit and --offset to inspect them; their Retry/Ignore actions target this root summary.
messages.proof-notice-guidance: . Files remain protected and will retry automatically. Check access and the journal, then Retry; Ignore hides this episode without abandoning verification.
messages.eligibility-rejected: Item is not eligible for this effect: {0}.
messages.proof-metadata-unavailable: Local path attributes could not be read safely:
messages.planning-settled: settled {0} of {1} candidates; rejected {3}; remaining planning backlog {2}
messages.duplicate-plan-action: Sync Shark could not distinguish two planned changes for this item. The extra change was not applied. Retry rebuilds the plan.
messages.planning-pair-mismatch: Pair does not match the planning snapshot.
messages.guardedInventoryIncomplete: The guarded inventory re-read could not completely observe this path.
messages.conflict-successors-missing: Conflict correspondence cannot be forgotten without its successors. Retry replans both copies; originals remain protected.
messages.baseline-unconfirmed: The completed operation lacks matching file content evidence. No baseline was saved; Retry verifies the item again.
messages.delete-source-moved: The original source survived at another path after an interrupted deletion. The delete was not acknowledged; Retry replans from the surviving identity.
messages.decisionNeeded: This item needs your decision; nothing was done to it yet. Choosing a version is not in core v2 yet.
messages.progressNotShown: Sync Shark could not show sync progress: {detail}
messages.progressAbandoned: The window did not take the last sync progress in time; that progress was not shown.
messages.firstSyncIncomplete: First sync not complete: {detail} reviewed effects deferred — run prepare and apply again with the same choices.
